name: TDD
description: Test-Driven Development workflow with test-first approach. Write comprehensive test cases before implementation, then implement code to pass tests. Suitable for new features following established patterns.

subagent.description: Planning is optional for TDD tasks with clear requirements and existing patterns. Use planning for complex or novel features.

workflowSteps.name: Review Task
workflowSteps.description: Read task definition, understand requirements, dependencies, and context

workflowSteps.name: Write Tests
workflowSteps.description: Create comprehensive test suite covering unit, integration, e2e, and edge cases

workflowSteps.name: Implement Code
workflowSteps.description: Write minimal code to pass all tests following best practices

workflowSteps.name: Refactor
workflowSteps.description: Improve code quality while maintaining passing tests

workflowSteps.name: Verify
workflowSteps.description: Run full test suite, check TypeScript compilation, verify coverage

useCases: Critical functionality requiring high test coverage
